episodes.description:

Some secrets are so powerful that it takes an assassination to expose them.

July 8, 2022. Former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe was shot during a campaign speech in Nara. As investigators searched for a motive, they uncovered a story that reached far beyond politics. 

What began as a murder investigation soon unraveled decades of allegations involving financial exploitation, shattered families, and a religious organization whose influence stretched across Japan, South Korea, and even the United States.

What investigators discovered left governments scrambling, victims finally speaking out, and an organization built over generations facing unprecedented scrutiny. But how did it become so powerful in the first place—and where did all that money really go?

Join Megan as she traces the rise of the Unification Church, the devastating impact its donation practices allegedly had on thousands of followers, and the investigation that transformed one of Japan's most shocking assassinations into an international political scandal.

How far would you go if you truly believed your family's salvation depended on it?
